definition: used to politely check that someone is willing to do something or let you do something
exampleSentence: I'd like to open the window, if you don't mind.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn mở cửa sổ, nếu bạn không phiền.

definition: used when you add something to emphasize what you have just said
translation: nếu có gì thì, thậm chí còn
exampleSentence: I'm not tired. If anything, I feel more awake than before.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không mệt. Nếu có gì thì tôi còn tỉnh táo hơn trước.

definition: used to emphasize that a situation or decision cannot be changed
translation: thế là xong, vậy là hết chuyện
exampleSentence: I've made up my mind, and that's that.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã quyết định rồi, vậy là hết chuyện.

definition: used to tell someone to stop doing something
exampleSentence: That's enough! Go to your room.
exampleTranslation: Đủ rồi đấy! Về phòng đi.

definition: used after a list of things to say that there are many more you could mention
translation: bạn kể tên gì cũng có
exampleSentence: They sell shoes, bags, hats, you name it.
exampleTranslation: Họ bán giày, túi, mũ, bạn kể tên gì cũng có.

definition: used to say you understand what someone means, although they have not said it directly
translation: tôi hiểu rồi, khỏi nói thêm
exampleSentence: "I need a quiet night with my partner." "Say no more."
exampleTranslation: "Tôi cần một buổi tối yên tĩnh với người yêu." "Tôi hiểu rồi, khỏi nói thêm."

definition: used to ask someone to speak more loudly
exampleSentence: Could you speak up, please? I can't hear you.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nói to lên được không? Tôi không nghe được.

definition: used to encourage someone to try to achieve something
exampleSentence: If you want to start your own business, go for it!
exampleTranslation: Nếu bạn muốn tự kinh doanh thì cứ làm đi!

definition: used to show surprise, especially when you are annoyed
exampleSentence: Good heavens! Is that the time?
exampleTranslation: Trời ơi! Giờ đã muộn thế này rồi sao?

definition: said when you are surprised or sometimes angry
exampleSentence: Goodness gracious! Look at all this mess.
exampleTranslation: Trời đất ơi! Nhìn đống bừa bộn này xem.

definition: used to show that you are very glad about something
exampleSentence: Thank goodness you're safe!
exampleTranslation: May quá, bạn bình an!

definition: used to show that you are very glad about something
exampleSentence: Thank God it's Friday!
exampleTranslation: Tạ ơn trời, hôm nay là thứ Sáu!

definition: used to emphasize that you do not know something
exampleSentence: Heaven knows where he put the keys.
exampleTranslation: Có trời mới biết anh ấy để chìa khóa ở đâu.

definition: used to show you are annoyed because you do not know something, or because something seems unreasonable
exampleSentence: God knows how long this meeting will last.
exampleTranslation: Có trời mới biết cuộc họp này kéo dài bao lâu.

definition: used to ask politely for something or to ask someone to do something
translation: không biết bạn có thể... không
exampleSentence: I wonder if you could help me with this form.
exampleTranslation: Không biết bạn có thể giúp tôi điền mẫu đơn này không.

definition: said to show that you are very angry and shocked about what someone has done or said
translation: sao bạn dám, sao bạn dám như vậy
exampleSentence: How dare you speak to me like that!
exampleTranslation: Sao bạn dám nói với tôi như vậy!

definition: used when you say something that is not related to the main subject you were talking about
exampleSentence: By the way, Vicky called while you were out.
exampleTranslation: Nhân tiện, Vicky có gọi khi bạn đi vắng.

definition: used when you say an idea again in a different and usually simpler way
exampleSentence: He is not available. In other words, he doesn't want to see you.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy không rảnh. Nói cách khác, ông ấy không muốn gặp bạn.

definition: used before you mention a specific thing or person to explain or support what you mean
exampleSentence: Many countries, for example Japan, drive on the left.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều nước, ví dụ như Nhật Bản, đi bên trái đường.

definition: used before you mention a specific thing or person to explain or support what you mean
exampleSentence: Some jobs, for instance nursing, need a lot of patience.
exampleTranslation: Một số nghề, chẳng hạn điều dưỡng, cần rất nhiều sự kiên nhẫn.

definition: used when you add something, often surprising, to emphasize what you have just said
exampleSentence: I like cold weather. In fact, I prefer it to summer.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích thời tiết lạnh. Thực ra tôi thích nó hơn mùa hè.

definition: used when you add more details to what you have just said
translation: thực ra, nói đúng ra thì
exampleSentence: "Do you know Tom?" "As a matter of fact, he's my cousin."
exampleTranslation: "Bạn có biết Tom không?" "Thực ra anh ấy là anh họ của tôi."

definition: used when you tell someone what you really think
exampleSentence: To be honest, I didn't enjoy the film.
exampleTranslation: Nói thật là tôi không thích bộ phim đó.

definition: used to emphasize that you are being very honest
translation: nói thật, thành thật mà nói
exampleSentence: To tell the truth, I forgot your birthday.
exampleTranslation: Thành thật mà nói, tôi đã quên sinh nhật của bạn.

definition: used when you are going to say something true that other people may not like
exampleSentence: To be frank, your work needs a lot of improvement.
exampleTranslation: Nói thẳng ra, bài làm của bạn cần cải thiện nhiều.

definition: used when you want to give the main point of something
exampleSentence: The food was cold and the service was slow. In short, we won't go back.
exampleTranslation: Đồ ăn nguội và phục vụ chậm. Tóm lại, chúng tôi sẽ không quay lại.

definition: in as few words as possible
translation: nói ngắn gọn, tóm gọn lại
exampleSentence: In brief, the plan failed because we ran out of money.
exampleTranslation: Nói ngắn gọn, kế hoạch thất bại vì chúng tôi hết tiền.

definition: used when you state the main facts about something in a short, clear way
translation: nói gọn lại, tóm lại một câu
exampleSentence: In a nutshell, we need more staff and more money.
exampleTranslation: Nói gọn lại, chúng ta cần thêm nhân viên và thêm tiền.

definition: used in writing or a speech to show that you are about to finish
exampleSentence: In conclusion, exercise is good for both body and mind.
exampleTranslation: Để kết luận, tập thể dục tốt cho cả cơ thể lẫn tinh thần.

definition: used to give the main points of a report or speech in a short statement at the end
exampleSentence: To sum up, the project was late but successful.
exampleTranslation: Tóm tắt lại, dự án bị trễ nhưng thành công.

definition: used to show that you are considering every part of a situation
exampleSentence: All in all, it was a good trip.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn chung, đó là một chuyến đi tốt.

definition: used to say that something is generally true
exampleSentence: On the whole, people here are very friendly.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn chung, người dân ở đây rất thân thiện.

definition: used to introduce a statement that is true in most cases but not always
exampleSentence: Generally speaking, the shops open at nine.
exampleTranslation: Nói chung, các cửa hàng mở cửa lúc chín giờ.

definition: used to say what is normal or usually true
exampleSentence: As a rule, I go to bed before eleven.
exampleTranslation: Thường thì tôi đi ngủ trước mười một giờ.

definition: used when you make a general statement
exampleSentence: By and large, the students enjoyed the course.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn chung, học viên thích khóa học này.

definition: almost, or approximately
exampleSentence: I've more or less finished the report.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gần như đã làm xong báo cáo.

definition: partly, but not completely
translation: ở một mức độ nào đó
exampleSentence: To some extent, I agree with you.
exampleTranslation: Ở một mức độ nào đó, tôi đồng ý với bạn.

definition: used to say that a statement is true in one respect but not in every respect
translation: theo một cách nào đó, ở một khía cạnh nào đó
exampleSentence: In a way, losing the job was a good thing.
exampleTranslation: Theo một cách nào đó, mất việc lại là điều tốt.

definition: used when you give your own ideas or beliefs about something
exampleSentence: In my opinion, the first plan is better.
exampleTranslation: Theo ý kiến của tôi, kế hoạch đầu tiên tốt hơn.

definition: used to say that you think something is true, although you may not know all the facts
exampleSentence: As far as I know, the shop closes at six.
exampleTranslation: Theo những gì tôi biết, cửa hàng đóng cửa lúc sáu giờ.

definition: used when you give your opinion about something
translation: theo tôi thì, về phần tôi
exampleSentence: As far as I'm concerned, the meeting was a waste of time.
exampleTranslation: Theo tôi thì cuộc họp đó là phí thời gian.

definition: used when you start to talk about someone or something new that is connected with what you were saying
exampleSentence: I'll cook dinner. As for the dishes, you can wash them.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ nấu bữa tối. Còn về chén bát thì bạn rửa nhé.

definition: in addition to something or someone else
exampleSentence: I'm going to the party, and my brother is coming as well.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ đi dự tiệc, và em trai tôi cũng đi nữa.

definition: used to say that something happens because of something that happened before
exampleSentence: It rained all week. As a result, the match was cancelled.
exampleTranslation: Trời mưa cả tuần. Do đó, trận đấu bị hủy.

definition: used to introduce the first of two opposite points or facts
exampleSentence: On the one hand, the job pays well. On the other hand, the hours are long.
exampleTranslation: Một mặt, công việc trả lương cao. Mặt khác, giờ làm rất dài.

definition: used to give another opinion or fact that should be considered as well as the one you have just given
exampleSentence: Cities are exciting. On the other hand, they can be very noisy.
exampleTranslation: Thành phố rất sôi động. Mặt khác, chúng có thể rất ồn ào.

definition: used to disagree with a negative statement by someone else, or to answer no to a question
exampleSentence: "Are you bored?" "On the contrary, I'm enjoying myself."
exampleTranslation: "Bạn chán à?" "Ngược lại, tôi đang rất vui."

definition: used to show that two things you are comparing are very different
exampleSentence: Summers here are dry. By contrast, winters are very wet.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè ở đây khô. Ngược lại, mùa đông rất ẩm ướt.

definition: used to show that two things you are comparing are very different
exampleSentence: Her sister is shy. In contrast, she loves meeting new people.
exampleTranslation: Em gái cô ấy nhút nhát. Ngược lại, cô ấy thích gặp người mới.

definition: used to add another piece of information to what you have just said
exampleSentence: The hotel is cheap. In addition, it is close to the beach.
exampleTranslation: Khách sạn giá rẻ. Ngoài ra, nó còn gần bãi biển.
